min_standing_note.value: Specialized Master exchange requires completed undergraduate degree and <=3 years work experience; International MBA exchange requires >=3 years work experience.

min_gpa_host.notes: EADA evaluates candidates holistically; no numeric minimum GPA published for incoming exchange students.

instruction_languages.notes: English-taught Master and MBA exchange tracks (bilingual/Spanish tracks separate).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Home-institution English sufficiency letter accepted for standard term exchange (interview if needed); Double Degree applicants require GMAT 650 and TOEFL iBT 100 or IELTS 7.0.

host_language_requirement.value: None required for English-taught Master and MBA exchange terms.

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: International MBA Sep 28-Dec 18, 2026; Specialized Masters Oct 7-Dec 18, 2026.

seat_quota.notes: Fact sheet p.6 states general programme caps (max 2 seats per Master programme, max 1 seat per MBA programme) rather than a specific AUC bilateral quota.

tuition_model.notes: Agreement type suggests bilateral exchange, though AY 2026-2027 fact sheet and observed eada.edu pages do not explicitly state incoming exchange tuition waiver terms.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Fact sheet p.10 breakdown: accommodation EUR 450-900, food EUR 250-450, utilities EUR 100-200, transport EUR 60-70, other EUR 250-450.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month midpoint estimate from EUR 1,110-2,070/month (EUR 1,590/mo) converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (collected 2026-11-15, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); math: 1,590 * 5 * 1.1052 = 8,786.34 USD (approx. USD 8,786).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Spanish public health system excludes international students; private health insurance strongly recommended plus FIATC accident insurance coverage.

housing_availability.notes: EADA has no on-campus dormitories in Barcelona; external housing platforms provided.

housing_notes.value: No on-campus housing; estimated off-campus rent EUR 450-900/month plus utilities EUR 100-200/month.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Merit/diversity scholarships (10-40%) on EADA website apply to full-degree tuition-paying applicants, not incoming exchange.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Non-EU students require a Spanish student visa; AY 2026-2027 fact sheet does not specify incoming Master/MBA visa lead times or financial proof thresholds.

exchange_page_url.notes: No dedicated public incoming-exchange URL published on eada.edu (administered via exchange@eada.edu and Qualtrics application portal in fact sheet).

course_catalog_url.notes: EADA links 9 individual Master/MBA programme pages in fact sheet p.6 rather than a single unified exchange course catalog.

english_course_list_url.notes: Individual English-taught Master and MBA programme links provided in fact sheet p.6.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system; Fall Masters ~16-17 ECTS, Winter Masters 25-29 ECTS; all courses in the chosen term/programme are mandatory.

course_restrictions_note.value: Students cannot mix courses across different Master/MBA programmes; all term courses are mandatory; max 2 seats per Master programme and max 1 seat per MBA programme.
course_restrictions_note.notes: Seat limits on p.6; programme lock and mandatory term coursework on p.7.

academic_style.value: Case study, role-play, and experiential outdoor leadership training modules at the Collbató residential campus.

city_tier.notes: Barcelona is Spain's second-largest city; schema city_tier label not explicitly classified in fact sheet.

campus_type.notes: Urban Barcelona city-centre campus (Aragó 204) plus Collbató residential training campus 40 km outside Barcelona.

international_support_services.value: Exchange coordinator desk (exchange@eada.edu), external housing assistance links (Studentfy), and FIATC accident insurance guidance.

nomination_deadlines.value: AY 2026-2027 deadlines: Fall May 4, 2026; Winter Sep 14, 2026 (nomination/application).
